threshold.message: Need at least {{threshold}} {{noun}} to show meaningful patterns. You have {{current}} so far.

list.meaning: No completed drives have been recorded for this vehicle yet.
list.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle has not driven since it was linked, or the selected date range ends before the first recorded drive.

list.meaning: No charging sessions have been recorded for this vehicle yet.
list.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle has not charged since it was linked, or it charged while asleep and unreachable.

degradation.meaning: There is not enough history yet to estimate battery degradation.
degradation.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle was linked recently, so the observation window is still too short to be meaningful.

list.meaning: No automations are configured, so nothing is being evaluated.
list.likelyCause: This list is empty by default — automations are opt-in and are never created for you.

live.meaning: No live signals are arriving for this vehicle right now.
live.likelyCause: Most often the vehicle is asleep — Tesla stops streaming while a car sleeps, and waking it costs range.

list.meaning: No alerts have fired — this is the expected steady state.
list.likelyCause: Either no rules are configured yet, or every rule has evaluated cleanly in the selected window.

efficiency.meaning: No efficiency figures can be computed for the selected period.
efficiency.likelyCause: Most often the selected range contains no completed drives — widen it before assuming data is missing.

list.meaning: No vehicles are linked, so nothing is being collected anywhere in the app.
list.likelyCause: Either setup has not been completed, or the stored Tesla authorisation was revoked and needs renewing.
